tag_schema.primary_silhouette: Main bounding shape — shield, circle, badge outline
tag_schema.secondary_silhouette: Inner border or secondary outline/double-line frame
tag_schema.color_field_primary: Largest color fill zone behind the crest
tag_schema.hero_graphic: Main central icon, mascot or emblem
tag_schema.sub_graphic_a: Secondary icon — wreath, laurel, cross, sword
tag_schema.sub_graphic_b: Tertiary icon — small details, footballs, motifs
tag_schema.crest_top: Element at top of crest — crown, stars, banner
tag_schema.crest_bottom: Element at bottom — ribbon, scroll, base
tag_schema.pattern_fill: Repeating decorative pattern — checker, stripes, dots
tag_schema.badge_element: Specific badge, patch or seal within the crest
tag_schema.typography_labels: Federation name or abbreviation text — STRIP from output
tag_schema.typography_motto: Motto or secondary text — STRIP from output
